function.name: aura_argus_search
function.description: Retrieve citable passages from primary sources (registry + default/user site packs) for one technical or factual question. Prefer over a generic web search for API docs, pricing, config, lifecycle, and error-code questions. Returns evidence passages with source URLs and origins; mode=none means the question is outside coverage.

site.description: Restrict to one domain and fetch the top matching pages as evidence.

sites.description: Include default/user site packs (default true). Set false for strict registry-only coverage.

multi.description: Route comparative questions to multiple entities (default: auto).

followLinks.description: Follow one same-host documentation link when key facets are missing.

fast.description: Use the local section index for fact-lookup questions; falls back to live retrieval.

docVersion.description: Prefer versioned docs for entities with a version map, e.g. 20, 3.11, 8.0, 16.

deepIndex.description: Use a deep local index (aura-argus index --deep) when it fully answers the question.

fallback.description: CLI/MCP default auto: official evidence first, web fallback only when needed. Set false to disable.

function.name: aura_argus_search_batch
function.description: Run multiple independent questions in one call. Keeps per-question results, bounded concurrency, and a shared page cache; at most 20 questions.

site.description: Restrict every question to one domain.

multi.description: Route comparative questions to multiple entities (default: auto).

followLinks.description: Follow one same-host documentation link when key facets are missing.

fast.description: Use the local section index for fact-lookup questions; falls back to live retrieval.

docVersion.description: Prefer versioned docs for entities with a version map, e.g. 20, 3.11, 8.0, 16.

deepIndex.description: Use a deep local index when it fully answers the question.

fallback.description: CLI/MCP default auto: official evidence first, web fallback only when needed. Set false to disable.

function.name: aura_argus_fetch
function.description: Fetch one public HTTP(S) URL and return clean Markdown with title, length, and truncation flag. Private/loopback targets are blocked by default.

function.name: aura_argus_sources
function.description: List covered entities, their primary sources and origins, so the caller knows whether search has authoritative coverage.
